title: I feel like we got a lot of guys that got each other's …

I feel like we got a lot of guys that got each other's … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS I feel like we got a lot of guys that got each other's …
 HoopsHype Oct. 15, 2026, 6:23 p.m. ET Thuc Nhi Nguyen: Quentin Grimes on what he's learned during preseason about the Lakers: "I feel like everybody got each other's back in practice, in games, in the locker room. ... I feel like we got a lot of guys that got each other's back and that's going to be big going on a 82-game season.”
